notes_for_editor: Only one source places this tower: the tnlandforms.us compiled list, row GA116, with no codes and no unit on the elevation (the record's 59.1 m assumes feet, which fits the rest of the list). Not on the NHLR Georgia list (29 entries, read in full), the Former Fire Lookout Sites Georgia list (2 sites), or the Eastern US Lookouts Georgia list, which has no Atkinson County or Pearson tower entry. Two web searches (general Pearson or Atkinson County fire lookout, and Atkinson forestry) found no tower record. The Vanishing Georgia tag page mentions Pearson GA only as a place caption. The search snippets mention a Georgia Forestry Commission office in Pearson, but that is unrelated to any tower and was not read. The story is about 80 words, below the 120-word floor, because nothing else describes the tower; suggest holding it as a stub. No photos. Next checks if time allows: Georgia Forestry Commission tower records for Atkinson County, Atkinson County Historical Society, Willacoochee or Pearson newspaper archives.
